notes: Strict Rully AOC specifications. Current INAO records confirm the AOP, red/white production, and 23 Premier Cru climats. The current homologating decree n°2011-1704 remains in force. Numeric production constraints are taken from the published Rully specification text carried into the 2011 homologation. Red accessory Chardonnay and Pinot Gris are vineyard co-planting exceptions and are not promoted as ordinary cellar-blend choices.
